newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle steady-firm - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle steady-firm - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady to firm, compared with Tuesday's close, USDA said.
Trade was moderate and demand moderate to strong. Seller interest moderate. Offerings light.
Steers - mostly Choice 2-4 1250 lbs ld 75.00. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lbs 73.00-74.50 mostly Choice to 75.00.
On a carcass basis (weight only) compared with Tuesday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were steady to firm, instances $1.00 higher.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs 118.25-119.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 108.00-109.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 111.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 98.00.
Heifers - Select and Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lbs 117.50-120.00 latter price mostly Choice. Confirmed- 2,200 Week Ago - 10,600 Year Ago - 10,000
Wk to Date- 19,500 Week Ago - 17,700 Year Ago - 26,800
